Description:
  Scan code, repositories, artifacts, and cloud sources for secrets.

Usage:
  picket [command] [options]

Options:
  -l, --log-level <level>  Set the log level.
  -v, --verbose            Enable verbose logging.
  --no-color               Disable colored console output.
  --no-banner              Suppress the startup banner.
  -?, -h, --help           Show help and usage information
  --version                Show version information

Commands:
  scan <path>                  Native filesystem and source-host scan.
  verify <path>                Run native verification for detected findings.
  analyze <path>               Write incident-response analysis for detected findings.
  revoke                       Explicit credential revocation workflows.
  baseline                     Baseline workflow commands.
  cache                        Native scan cache maintenance.
  git <repo>                   Scan git history using the Gitleaks-compatible patch model.
  dir, directory, file <path>  Scan a directory or file path.
  stdin                        Scan piped input.
  rules                        Rule pack commands.
  hooks                        Install Git hooks that block commits and pushes containing findings.
  agent                        Coding-agent security hooks.
  view <report>                Summarize or open a local report.
  tui <report>                 Interactive report triage and scan workspace.
  version                      Print version information.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Native filesystem and source-host scan.

Usage:
  picket scan [<path>] [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  Filesystem path to scan. Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

Options:
  -b, --baseline-path <path>                                         Load a baseline report and suppress matching findings.
  --baseline-mode <exact|portable>                                   Compare baseline findings exactly or treat LF and CRLF evidence as equivalent. Requires a native command or --profile picket.
  -c, --config <path>                                                Load a config file.
  -f, --report-format <json|jsonl|csv|junit|html|gitlab|sarif|toon>  Select report format.
  -r, --report-path <path>                                           Write a report to this path.
  --profile <profile>                                                Use the named rule/profile mode.
  --rule-pack <name>                                                 Add an opt-in built-in rule pack. Values: picket-strict or picket-experimental. Repeat to add both.
  --source <path>                                                    Override the source label stored in findings and fingerprints.
  --ignore-path <path>                                               Load additional patterns from an ignore file. The value is a file path, not a glob.
  --no-ignore                                                        Do not apply ignore files.
  --cache-dir <path>                                                 Read or write scanner cache data in this directory.
  --cache-mode <mode>                                                Choose whether scan cache entries store raw evidence or secret and match hashes only.
  --checkpoint <path>                                                Persist encrypted native source-scan progress here and resume it when the source snapshot still matches.
  --checkpoint-reset                                                 Discard existing checkpoint state before starting the native source scan.
  --e
[truncated]

  --report-template <path>                             Render template reports with this template file.
  --enable-rule <id>                                   Enable an additional rule by ID.
  --exit-code <n>                                      Exit with this code when findings are present.
  --ignore-gitleaks-allow                              Do not honor gitleaks:allow comments.
  --log-opts <value>                                   Pass git log options for compatibility scans.
  --platform <value>                                   Set compatibility platform metadata.
  --staged                                             Scan staged changes.

  --max-target-megabytes <n>                           Skip files larger than this size.

  --source <path>              Override the source label stored in findings and fingerprints.
  --ignore-path <path>         Load additional patterns from an ignore file. The value is a file path, not a glob.
  --no-ignore                  Do not apply ignore files.
  --enable-rule <id>           Enable an additional rule by ID.

  --max-target-megabytes <n>   Skip files larger than this size.
  --max-archive-depth <n>      Limit nested archive traversal depth.
  --max-archive-entries <n>    Limit files extracted from each archive.
  --max-archive-megabytes <n>  Limit uncompressed archive size.
  --max-archive-ratio <n>      Limit archive expansion ratio.
  --timeout <n>                Stop scanning after this many seconds. Use 0 to disable.
  --diagnostics <mode[,mode]>  Write structured diagnostics for the selected modes.
  --diagnostics-dir <path>     Write diagnostics artifacts to this directory.
  --redact <n>                 Redact secret text in reports. n is the percent to hide: 0 shows secrets, 100 writes REDACTED, and 75 keeps about the first 25%.

  -l, --log-level <level>      Set the log level.
